campaign.provenance_note: The original campaign sprint document and report package were not committed. This package reconstructs durable evidence from the promoted regression tests and their source comments at commit 12cfef8; it is not an original worker transcript.

summary.description: Three promoted 20260817-1 findings remain documented as historical fuzz evidence.

workers.fuzz_run_description: Legacy JSON null representation at different nesting depths
workers.context_text: Post-hoc reconstruction from the promoted test and its 20260817-1 source comment. The test demonstrates that Legacy JSON rendering emits different textual null representations by nesting depth.

test_inputs.description: Render `{ "n": "{{ n }}" }` under Legacy mode with top-level, array-nested, and object-nested JSON null values.
test_inputs.outcome: FAIL: output diverges as empty string, `[none]`, and `{\"x\": none}` rather than one JSON-safe null representation.

findings.expected_oracle: A JSON null leaf has one consistent JSON-safe representation regardless of structured nesting.
findings.observed_result: Legacy mode emits an empty string for a top-level null but minijinja-style `none` for nested null values.
findings.requirement_trace: No requirement or ADR currently covers this Legacy-mode null rendering invariant.
findings.requirement_follow_up: Treat as a renderer compatibility decision; preserve the minimized regression until the intended Legacy representation is selected.
findings.root_cause: Nested values reach minijinja's Python-style null formatting while a top-level null takes a separate coercion path.
findings.recommended_fix: Serialize JSON null consistently at every nesting depth, then update this test to the selected contract.

workers.fuzz_run_description: TOML formula interpolation containing quotes and backslashes
workers.context_text: Post-hoc reconstruction from the promoted test and its 20260817-1 source comment. The template probe shows that TOML formula suffixes do not receive string-safe escaping.

test_inputs.description: Render TOML template `a = "{{{ x }}}"` with literal quotes and a backslash in `x`.
test_inputs.outcome: FAIL: interpolated quotes and backslashes are unescaped, producing invalid quoted TOML.

findings.expected_oracle: A quoted TOML formula value either renders as valid TOML or fails with an explicit diagnostic.
findings.observed_result: The value is embedded without TOML string escaping.
findings.requirement_trace: ADR-0021 makes formula rendering a sc-composer-beads responsibility but does not define TOML escaping semantics.
findings.requirement_follow_up: Define the intended TOML formula rendering contract before implementing format-aware escaping or a fail-closed validation error.
findings.root_cause: `.formula.toml.j2` receives the generic auto-escape mode, which has no TOML string-safety branch.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a TOML-aware render path or reject unsafe interpolated TOML strings before emitting a formula.

workers.fuzz_run_description: Distinct formula render failures retain distinguishable diagnostics
workers.context_text: Post-hoc reconstruction from the promoted test and its 20260817-1 source comment. Two structurally different render errors collapse into one opaque message.

test_inputs.description: Compare malformed-template and missing-variable formula render failures.
test_inputs.minimal_template: An unterminated triple-brace expression and a separate missing-variable expression.
test_inputs.minimal_input: No additional compose variables for the missing-variable case.
test_inputs.outcome: FAIL: both conditions report the same fixed `template rendering failed` message.

findings.minimal_template: hello {{{ unterminated; and a separate template referencing a missing value
findings.minimal_input: structured compose variables lacking the referenced value
findings.expected_oracle: Distinct render failures retain cause-specific details for diagnostics.
findings.observed_result: `RenderError::Display` collapses both causes to the same opaque text.
findings.requirement_trace: ADR-0021 requires retained rendering failure details for Beads diagnostics.
findings.requirement_follow_up: No new ADR is needed; implementation must satisfy the existing retained-detail contract.
findings.root_cause: The adapter uses `RenderError::to_string()` instead of its cause-specific `message()` accessor.
findings.recommended_fix: Use the cause-specific render error message when constructing `BeadComposeError::RenderFailed`.
